no2_ppm_to_ugm3.source: WHO global air quality guidelines (2021), ISBN 9789240034228, section 3.5 (nitrogen dioxide): 1 ppm = 1.914 mg/m³.

no2_ppb_to_ugm3.source: Same WHO factor divided by 1000 (1 ppm = 1000 ppb).

kg_per_m3_to_ugm3.source: SI prefixes (1 kg = 10^9 µg). Used for CAMS particulate_matter_2.5um, delivered in kg m-3, and for CAMS nitrogen dioxide once its mass mixing ratio has been multiplied by air density.

dry_air_gas_constant.source: ECMWF, IFS Documentation Cy47r3, Part IV: Physical Processes (2021), chapter 12, section 12.5, page 210: R_d = R/M_d = 287.0597 J kg-1 K-1, with R = 8.31451 J K-1 mol-1 and M_d = 28.9644e-3 kg mol-1. These are the constants of the IFS model that produces CAMS. CC BY 4.0.
dry_air_gas_constant.used_for: Air density for the CAMS NO2 layer, rho = p / (R_d T), from surface pressure (Pa) and 2 m temperature (K). Treats the air as dry, so the result is an approximation.
